repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The IR specifies a rising-edge wait on Button3. The candidate polls the condition at the start of the body (line 2) but fails to block until the edge occurs. Evidence F2 shows the button was already 'pushed' at t=100ms, but the JoI emitted no action because the `if` guard evaluated the state at t=0 (null) or the logic flow prevented execution. The IR requires blocking on the rising edge before the call.
diagnosis.change_summary: Replaced the periodic polling `if` with the required rising-edge state machine: initialize `fired=false`, check if already fired to block until false, then block until true, execute body, and mark fired. This ensures the action only occurs on the rising edge and respects the 1-second cycle period.
